caption: A dry log is tossed onto a campfire, and a burst of sparks flies up into the night.

sa.check: A log is tossed onto the fire.
A burst of sparks flies up.
The flames climb around the new log.
The sparks go dark as they rise.
The toss comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: The sparks rise with the hot air above the fire, drift and go dark.
pc.fail: The sparks fall straight to the ground and lie there glowing; or sink below the fire; or hang still in the air; or travel downward from the fire into the ground.

pc.expect: The sparks leave the fire where the log lands, spread outward as they rise and their paths curve with the rising air.
pc.fail: The sparks rise in straight parallel lines with no spread; or fly out from a point away from where the log landed; or all turn together at the same instant as if steered; or race ahead of the rising smoke and stop dead.

pc.expect: The burst comes at the moment the log lands and then eases, and each spark only fades.
pc.fail: The sparks burst before the log lands; or a spark brightens again after fading; or the burst grows steadily with nothing added; or the burst stops and starts again with the fire untouched.

pc.expect: The log's landing shows: the fire's logs shift, the flames are pushed aside and then climb around the new log.
pc.fail: The log lands and the fire is unchanged, with the flames steady and the logs unmoved; or the flames are pushed aside before the log arrives; or the log rests on the flames without touching the wood beneath.

pc.expect: One log is added and the fire's logs keep their number; sparks come from the fire and go dark rather than vanishing at a stroke while bright.
pc.fail: The log vanishes on landing; or a second log appears in the air; or a log passes through another log; or sparks appear in the sky far from the fire with none rising there.

pc.expect: The fire's stones, the ground and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The stones around the fire rearrange; or the ground changes texture; or the background changes between frames.
